description: This file defines the UserDataRepository interface for managing user-specific data and settings in the Android application, including themes, topic followings, bookmarked resources, and onboarding status.

classes.name: UserDataRepository
classes.description: An interface for user data management, including preferences, followings, and viewed/bookmarked resources.

methods.name: userData
methods.description: A Flow stream emitting current UserData.

methods.name: setFollowedTopicIds
methods.description: Sets the list of topic IDs that the user is following.

methods.name: setTopicIdFollowed
methods.description: Updates follow status for a specific topic.

methods.name: setNewsResourceBookmarked
methods.description: Updates the bookmarked status of a news resource.

methods.name: setNewsResourceViewed
methods.description: Updates the viewed status of a news resource.

methods.name: setThemeBrand
methods.description: Sets the user's preferred theme brand.

methods.name: setDynamicColorPreference
methods.description: Enables or disables dynamic color preference.

methods.name: setShouldHideOnboarding
methods.description: Marks whether the onboarding process is completed and should be hidden.
